title: Test Movie: Ruffle warns about unknown device fonts (Noto Sans, AppleGothic)
description:
Fixed in packages/player/src/RufflePlayer.tsx:

1. Added stripConsoleCssFormat() function that strips %c tokens from the first console argument and discards trailing CSS style args. E.g. '%cWARN%c core/src/library.rs:559%c msg' becomes 'WARN core/src/library.rs:559 msg'.

2. Updated isRuffleInternalLog() to call stripConsoleCssFormat() before checking prefixes, so '%cWARN%c ...' is correctly identified as an internal log (starts with 'warn' after stripping).

3. Added console.warn interceptor alongside the existing console.log interceptor. Ruffle emits its diagnostic messages (WARN, ERROR, INFO level) via console.warn with CSS format tokens. The interceptor now catches these, strips %c tokens, and filters out internal Ruffle messages (device font warnings etc.) before they reach the Output panel.

4. Added origConsoleWarnRef to restore console.warn on unmount alongside the existing console.log restore.

Build verified: pnpm --filter @flash/player run build and pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run build both pass with no errors.
